notes.title: September Update
notes.content:
Hey everybody!

It’s been a while since we shared our progress, so we are happy to finally give you an update on what we have been working on!

First of all, I’m proud to show off the current talent tree. We added 10(!) new talents so far, which brings the current total to 19, more than twice the amount of the Demo!

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/9ea78f47fe45f9ed2186c56e2c87e3781c362806.png"]

I don’t want to spoil them all already, so you can speculate a bit based on the icons. Let’s take a look at only two of the new talents for now.



The first is one of the most suggested talents from the community, oxidizing copper coins. When you don’t interact with copper coins for a while they start to oxidize and then grant bonus money when you ultimately flip them.

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/f1218ee7f29d978312591816e42bc7a8548fdf96.png"]



The second one has been super fun to animate and made me laugh a few times^^

you vs. the guy she told you not to worry about:[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/5409f94ccd43ac324ad670c84c21fc7494038680.gif"]

We have also been sharing some very early work in progress screenshots of a new thief-helper and the table select mechanic on our Discord. If you would like to see stuff early or want to suggest ideas for new talents, we’d love to have you join the Gamblers Table Discord! But we’ll of course also show the new features here once they are a little more polished.

 

Lastly, we have reached a new milestone: We surpassed 50k Wishlists, mainly due to a huge influx of Japanese players. It seems like a bunch of Japanese influencers discovered Gamblers Table and played it on their channels. Thank you all for playing and covering Gamblers Table and for wishlisting and for following the development!

notes.title: The Gamblers Table Demo is Out Now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, great news: the Demo of Gamblers Table is now available!


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3747250/Gamblers_Table_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]
What to expect from the demo:
Toss coins to earn money

Buy new coins and upgrade them in a variety of ways

3 different coin types

Hire helpers to automate the coin tossing

Hats!

Prestige system: restart the game with powerful new talents

9 Unlockable talent points

Steamdeck support


This is just the beginning
We are already working on more content for the full game. We have teased a few features here in the community hub. Among other things, the full game will have: more coin types, different tables with unique effects, crazy upgrades like Rockets and Angels, significantly more talent points and much more!


Please give us Feedback!
If you play the demo please remember to write a review and let us know what you think. Our goal is to reach 100 Steam reviews! Sharing your feedback will improve the full version immensely! At least half the features in the game come from community suggestions, so we are happy to hear everyone’s ideas!



We can't wait to share more about the future of Gamblers Table soon! If you want to reach us, we try to read and answer every comment here on Steam and you can also join our Discord to chat about Gamblers Table, game development or other incremental games with us :)


Join our Discord!
